prior_credit.key_recovery: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker
prior_credit.earlier_candidate_layer: B3 already appeared as an unreviewed OCR-derived candidate at p228_ocr_block4 in /tmp/cross_key_plaintexts.json. B1 is now transcribed at its actual 246 slots rather than the earlier 241-coordinate OCR stream, which had no coherent reading. B2 was badly garbled in the earlier screen.
prior_credit.bounded_body_check: No explicit p228/Neuhof/Darmstadt/Flakabteilung example was located in the inspected author paper, supplementary readings or current catalog. This is not an exhaustive priority search.
prior_credit.contribution: Visual source edition, recovery of the opening demobilization instruction, a separately limited 33-character middle-part proposal, and exact repair costs; no new period-key recovery or universal first-decipherment claim.

limits: Raw Y is retained as the published label commonly separating words. The optional late-key symbol interpretation is not applied.
The main proposed strings retain NICHIN and DARMSADT; no T is inserted to normalize either phrase.
The Flak unit field ?0 and every reference/date label remain unresolved.
The middle part has 43 printed dashes, and its final 99 positions have no proposed coherent original reading.
